next-webpack-client.source: Next 16.3.6 webpack builds compose next's shipped maps to webpack://_N_E/../../src/client/…, 231 of 426 sources (spec §10).

angular-bazel.source: @angular/* packages built with Bazel ship maps into their Bazel output, <platform>-fastbuild-ST-<hash>/bin/packages/<pkg>/… (k8, darwin_arm64, …), which composes anywhere in a build's paths (spec §10).
